Hi Mike / Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can put together a tailored committed-use proposal and check eligibility for the startup program: 

1) What are your current and expected usage patterns? A rough monthly token range is fine (e.g., 0.5M–2M, 2M–10M, 10M+). Callouts we care about: average prompt length (tokens per request), peak qps, and percent of traffic that needs real-time latency vs. batch.

2) What budget range are you targeting for model inference (monthly)? If you have an internal $/1M-tokens target for procurement, share that — it helps us propose committed tiers that meet your unit economics.

3) Any constraints on term (12 vs 24 months), or preference for multi-year discounts / upfront commits?

Next steps from us after you confirm the numbers above: 1) draft committed-use tiers (tokens/month vs discount %), 2) check startup program eligibility and apply any additional credits, 3) produce a short mutual action plan and term sheet for procurement.

Attaching a one-pager with the current startup offer we discussed.

Thanks —

Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + ask on token volumes and target $/1M tokens

Thanks Aditya — appreciated the summary. A couple answers below: 

- Monthly tokens (current/predicted):
  - Current (pilot): ~800k tokens/month (mostly prompts + short responses)
  - Production (Q1 ramp): expect 4–6M tokens/month
  - Long term (FY27): planning for 20–30M tokens/month if latency/price are in line

- Avg tokens per request: ~120 tokens (prompt + response)
- Peak qps: low single digits now; expecting occasional spikes during end-of-day batch jobs
- Latency needs: ~80% real-time low latency, 20% can be async/batch

Budget: We don't have a fixed procurement number yet — leadership gave a target headline of $800–1,200/month to start for pilot but they expect to scale spend in line with usage. In procurement terms they're looking for unit economics under $15k per 1M tokens in pilot (yes, early-stage and high), with better targets as we scale (ideally $2k–$5k / 1M tokens at larger committed volumes).

Term preferences: Open to 12–24 month commitments if pricing supports it. Procurement will require an initial SOW and a straightforward term sheet.

Would love to see a committed-use example that maps to 5M and 25M token/mo tiers and the effective $/1M tokens at each tier (incl. any startup credits you can layer).

--
Mike Chen
Head of Product, DeepFin Inc
mike.chen@deepfin.ai

- Example pricing (net of committed discount, before startup credits):
  * 5M tokens/mo (3-month pilot commit): 40% off list -> effective ~$9k / 1M tokens
  * 25M tokens/mo (12-month commit): 70% off list -> effective ~$3k / 1M tokens
  * 25M tokens/mo (24-month commit, upfront): 75% off list + 5% multi-year incentive -> effective ~$2.85k / 1M tokens

- Startup program: we can apply an additional one-time credit for eligible early-stage companies (we'll need company details + YC/accelerator proof or recent seed round doc). Credits stack on top of committed discounts but are time-limited.

- Next steps:

  3) We'll send a short term sheet (no redlines) + DocuSign link and a HubSpot deal record for signature.
